findings.evidenceJa: もみくちゃに『してもらった』か…
findings.explanation: Haruki repeats Koharu's pointed benefactive phrasing, してもらった, after she says her friends roughed her up affectionately; the English replaces that linguistic observation with the invented sentence 'She still looked happy though.'
findings.japanese: もみくちゃに『してもらった』か…

findings.highlight: about 90% of it is impossible for this year
findings.explanation: The source says it is roughly ninety percent likely to be impossible this year. The translation makes ninety percent a portion of the task that is impossible, changing probability into quantity.
findings.japanese:
「………キツいぞ？
て言うか今年は９割方無理だぞ？」
findings.todokanai: "…It'll be very demanding, you know? Rather, I think about 90% of it is impossible for this year."

findings.highlight: It was Senpai who showed interest
findings.evidenceJa: 興味は先輩の方なんですか
findings.explanation: Koharu asks whether the coworkers' interest is actually directed at Haruki rather than at her. The translation instead makes Haruki the person who showed interest, reversing the joke's subject and object.
findings.japanese: 「興味は先輩の方なんですか…」
